shared_elements: upright monolithic stone slab as the carved field
frontal anthropomorphic figure with head at top and body below
relief carving (raised from a flat background)
paired rounded bosses/discs on the upper torso
horizontal band or ridge crossing the lower body
object resting on a stepped base/plinth
justification: Both are tall, frontal, vertically axial stone monuments on plinths in which an anthropomorphic body is laid out head-at-top with paired rounded bosses on the chest and a horizontal band crossing the lower torso, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The manner of rendering is quite different, however: A is a rounded, naturalistic, high-relief body in pale weathered stone set into a wall, while B is a dark, blocky monolith whose features are reduced to shallow, schematic geometric incisions and concentric circles.
